description: This file defines the FlexibleMessage class, which encapsulates logic for representing messages that can either be direct strings or derived from properties files, supporting localization and flexible message composition within the OFBiz minilang framework.

classes.name: FlexibleMessage
classes.description: A utility class for creating localized or flexible messages from direct strings or property files, capable of expanding expressions based on environment variables.

methods.name: FlexibleMessage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a FlexibleMessage instance from an XML element and a default property name, determining if the message is a direct string or needs to be retrieved from properties.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message string by expanding expressions or fetching from properties resource based on the given context and class loader.
